result.question: What happens to the man of God as he goes on his way?

readings.answer: A lion meets him on the road and kills him.
readings.support: a lion met him on the road and killed him

readings.answer: The LORD delivers him to a lion, which mauls and kills him.
readings.support: Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him

assessments.reason: Directly matches verse 13:24: “a lion met him on the road and killed him,” which answers what happened as he went on his way.
Verse 13:26 states, “the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him,” which adds cause but still correctly describes what happened to him as he went on his way.
